neighbours.label: the agent slot of a verification or approval passive: ' by' (and the following article) naming who audits, confirms or certifies ('audited by the Auditor General', 'confirmed by further surveys')
fire: All election results must be certified by the state board before Friday.
The financial statements were reviewed by an external auditor last month.
If the diagnosis is confirmed by a second biopsy, surgery will follow.
Each new drug must be approved by the regulator before sale.
The safety report was verified by independent inspectors in June.
These claims have not been checked by any outside expert.
The final design was signed off by the chief engineer yesterday.
Her findings were later replicated by two other laboratories.
quiet: All election results must be posted online by Friday evening.
The financial statements were sent by email last month.
If the diagnosis comes back by Monday, surgery will follow.
Each new drug must be shipped by air before sale.
The safety report was finished by the end of June.
These claims have grown by ten percent each year.
The final design was printed by hand yesterday.
Her findings were later sent by post to two other laboratories.

notes: Card peaks: ' by' x7 after audited/confirmed, 'invite an independent', 'to have MSHA take responsibility'. Probe: 'audited by an' 0.89, 'confirmed by' 0.61 vs 'by Friday' 0.00 and 'by train' 0.00. Near misses keep ' by' in time/means senses.
